units.purpose: Run all prior source and package gates plus the frozen two-build, container real-surface, scan, parity, and clean-clone checks.
retained_failures: Final source/package evaluation attempt 001 is excluded after a non-terminating PowerShell Test-Path guard error allowed both outputs to run. A subsequent trace-verifier probe also omitted PYTHONPATH and stopped at import. All six outputs and the exact wrapper failure remain retained; no image was built.

The first source-real-surface wrapper set only RUNBOOK_SENTINEL_PYTHONPATH; the MCP verifier itself stopped at import because PYTHONPATH was absent. No MCP/API/native output or image was created; exact failure receipt retained.

The first parity-summary hash helper used unavailable System.Convert.ToHexString. Reports remained unchanged; the supported SHA256.Create/ComputeHash path proved exact parity and the diagnostic is retained.

The first post-package aggregate regression invocation ran its designed evaluation-and-promotion tail after all validators and tests passed, creating a valid but unselected baseline-0027-attempt-002 and replacing latest.json. The three output files are retained; latest.json was restored exactly to the selected fail-fast final source attempt before the side-effect-free validator sweep.

The first side-effect-free validator wrapper omitted PYTHONPATH and stopped after 21 passes when verify_stale_payload_projection.py could not import runbook_sentinel. The corrected unchanged sweep set the exact source path and passed all 31 validators while latest.json remained selected exactly.

The first two-image build stopped before runtime verification because BuildKit assigned different current creation timestamps, producing image IDs e231ceed and 63f64522. A correction receipt records that the exact base has eleven layers and the candidates add a directory-only WORKDIR layer plus two COPY layers; the original failure outcome remains correct. No runtime, MCP, API, scan, export, or publication followed.

The second two-image build supplied SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH 1786556577. Both configs received the exact frozen creation time, but both COPY layer digests and image IDs still differed; no later gate ran. Official BuildKit semantics and exact logs are retained.

Two process-valid type=image rewrite-timestamp probes produced the same local image ID and frozen creation time, but are excluded from release evidence because the unchanged v2 Dockerfile still adds three layers and the exporter settings were not frozen before the probes. Container-runtime-v3 is now locally frozen before implementation; it preserves exactly two payload layers, moves WORKDIR after both COPY directives, and binds the timestamp, exporter, builder compatibility, clean-process, and no-publication checks.

The first v3 two-image run reproduced exact image ID ad9160e8... twice, then stopped before runtime because WORKDIR still emitted a canonical empty third layer and the exact Docker containerd store assigned a local content digest. Official Docker semantics, exact logs, and local-only events are retained. Container-runtime-v4 is frozen before implementation to remove only WORKDIR and verify local digest-to-ID equality without weakening push/export or runtime boundaries.
